Frequently Asked Questions

How many cubic yards of concrete do I need for a 8x8 slab at 4 inches thick?

A 8×8 (64 sq ft) 4" slab + 12"×12" thickened edge requires 1.58 net cubic yards. Adding the standard 10% subgrade/spillage waste allowance brings your order to 1.74 cubic yards (2 yards from a ready-mix truck).

How many 80 lb bags of concrete for a 8x8 slab?

Because each 80 lb bag of pre-mixed concrete yields 0.60 cubic feet, you need 79 bags of 80 lb concrete (1.9 pallets) or 105 bags of 60 lb concrete including 10% waste.

Is a ready-mix truck or bagged concrete cheaper for a 8x8 pour?

Bagged 80 lb concrete costs roughly $446 for materials alone, whereas ordering 2 cubic yards via ready-mix truck costs roughly $521 (including $185 short-load fee). Our recommended method: 80 lb Pre-Mixed Bags.
